findings.title: Canonical master board size
findings.detail: data/master.json carries 354 rows across 20 sports; its own counts block reports 354 rows total and 349 in scope.

findings.title: Canonical board is not today's board
findings.detail: 208 of 354 rows in data/master.json are dated before 24 Oct 2026 and 251 are dated on or before today; only 103 rows describe a future fixture. The file is regenerated by tools/build_master.py from the historical build files, so it will keep republishing yesterday's slate until those builds are re-run.

findings.title: Rows with no source link
findings.detail: 39 of 354 canonical rows (11%) carry no source_url at all. Example: M0001 — Aussie Rules — No fixture v No fixture.

findings.title: No canonical row leans on an aggregator or tipster site
findings.detail: 0 of 315 sourced canonical rows point at an OLBG page, a betting aggregator or a tipster site instead of a league/tour/federation page. Every sourced row cites a league, tour, federation or club body.

findings.title: Canonical predictions: length and wording
findings.detail: 76 rows carry prediction text; 0 are shorter than 30 words, 0 have no source link, and 49 use wording the brief forbids ("model", "verified").

findings.title: Repetition between published predictions
findings.detail: The most similar pair of prediction texts in the six most recently published desks scores 0.27 (1.00 = identical) in session-ed4c358c: ED-BB-849804 ↔ ED-BB-849803. Under 0.55 is what this desk requires of its own output.

findings.title: Broken internal links on published pages
findings.detail: 0 dead internal links found across 31 root pages.

findings.title: This desk: priced rows carry an official link
findings.detail: 15 of 15 priced rows on this desk cite the official source they were built from; every unpriced row states why.
